entry.title: New: Resolution 256 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I DEPARTMENT OF BUSINESS, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND TOURISM, PURSUANT TO HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT

Allows for the receipt of $175,000 in federally-derived funds to provide services and financial assistance for internet subscription fees for qualified households on Hawai‘i Island.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 256-23 & FC-74 - 10/04/23
